# `preview` operations

16 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### preview.sessions

**Preview sessions**

Find running Qt preview sessions owned by this OS user.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

Takes no arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call preview.sessions
```

### preview.configure

**Configure preview**

Set profile, orientation, fold state, insets, guides, zoom, the page's color scheme and reduced-motion preference, and network throttling, without reloading the page.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | string |  |  |  |
| `orientation` | string |  |  | one of `portrait`, `landscape` |
| `unfolded` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `safe_area` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `guides` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `status_bar` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `chrome_theme` | string |  |  | one of `auto`, `light`, `dark` |
| `zoom` | number |  |  | 0 to 3 |
| `color_scheme` | string |  |  | one of `system`, `light`, `dark`; prefers-color-scheme the page sees; system follows the desktop |
| `reduced_motion` | string |  |  | one of `system`, `reduce`, `no-preference`; prefers-reduced-motion the page sees; system follows the desktop |
| `network` | object |  |  | Throttle the page's requests or take it offline, through Chromium's DevTools network emulation. A preset sets every field; fields given with it override the preset. All zero and offline false turns throttling off. |
| `network.preset` | string |  |  | one of `none`, `fast-3g`, `slow-3g`, `offline`; Chromium DevTools' presets: fast-3g 562.5 ms, 1440/675 kbit/s; slow-3g 2000 ms, 400/400 kbit/s |
| `network.offline` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `network.latency_ms` | number |  |  | 0 to 60000; Added round-trip latency in milliseconds |
| `network.download_kbps` | number |  |  | 0 to 10000000; Download limit in kbit/s; 0 is unlimited |
| `network.upload_kbps` | number |  |  | 0 to 10000000; Upload limit in kbit/s; 0 is unlimited |
| `session` | string |  |  | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}`; Running preview session name; defaults to main |
| `ios_guest` | object |  |  | The virtual iOS guest display shown by the desktop for a running interactive guest job. |
| `ios_guest.detached` | boolean |  |  | Show the guest display as its own phone-shaped window, or dock it back into the dialog. A request to detach made while no interactive guest is running is kept for up to 10 minutes and applied when the guest starts; until then the returned state reports workspace.ios_research.guest.detach_pending as true. |
| `native` | object |  |  |  |
| `native.platform` | string |  |  | one of `android`, `ios` |
| `native.apple_target` | string |  |  | one of `device`, `simulator` |
| `native.setup` | boolean |  |  |  |
| `native.device` | string |  |  | non-empty, up to 200 characters; Select a native device by serial/UDID and attach its existing runtime session. |
| `native.connect` | boolean |  |  | With device: if no runtime session exists yet, the app waits for the device and starts one with its own settings (sound, iPhone runner, Mac). Its window shows the device frame and a startup screen until the stream is live; other sessions are not attached meanwhile. An existing session is shown as it is and never reconfigured. |
| `native.frame` | boolean |  |  | Show the matching native device frame. Never changes the guest hardware or screen geometry. |
| `native.detached` | boolean |  |  | Show the live device as its own frameless, device-shaped window instead of inside the workspace. The same display item moves; no second stream is opened. |
| `native.pending_avd` | string |  |  | up to 200 characters; Name of an Android virtual device that is starting. The device view shows its frame and a startup screen and attaches the real stream once Android has booted. An empty string clears it. |
| `native.profile_id` | string |  |  | up to 200 characters; Device profile for the startup frame of pending_avd or connect. |
| `native.solo` | boolean |  |  | With detached and a device window that is shown or on its way: hide the main window so the device window is the whole app. Closing that window stops its runtime session and ends the app; the device itself keeps running. With unsaved source edits, or once two minutes pass without any device window, the main window returns instead. desktop.open without device_only also brings it back. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call preview.configure
```

### preview.errors

**Page errors**

Report the current page load's errors as structured results: console errors, uncaught exceptions, unhandled promise rejections and failed requests (network errors and HTTP status 400 and above from fetch, XMLHttpRequest, elements, style sheets, fonts and the document), with clean true when there are none. reload:true reloads first and waits for the page, so the report covers exactly one load.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reload` | boolean |  | `false` | Reload the page and wait until it is ready before reporting |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `30` | 1 to 60; Seconds to wait for the reloaded page |
| `wait_for` | string |  | `""` | JavaScript expression that becomes true when application content is ready, after a reload |
| `session` | string |  |  | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}`; Running preview session name; defaults to main |

```sh
tomaccoctl call preview.errors
```

### preview.audit

**Check layout**

Check overflow of the page and its elements, text under the camera cutout or system bars, accessible names, input labels and target sizes (24 px, and 44 pt on iOS or 48 dp on Android), with a unique selector per finding; returns evidence, not a compliance certification.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `session` | string |  | `"main"` | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}`; Running preview session name; defaults to main |

```sh
tomaccoctl call preview.audit
```
